name: How long does drywall installation take in a typical kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How long does drywall installation take in a typical kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical kitchen drywall installation takes three to five days from hanging to final sanding. Hanging the boards usually takes a single day, while taping, applying multiple coats of joint compound, and allowing each layer to dry thoroughly takes an additional two to four days. Kitchen projects often involve extra detail work, such as cutting around complex plumbing lines, electrical outlets, and ventilation rough-ins, which adds finishing time. Proper drying time between mud coats cannot be rushed, especially before primer and finish paint or backsplash tile can be applied.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen drywall installation usually takes three to five days, including hanging the boards, applying multiple mud coats with proper drying time, and finish sanding.
